user_decision: Retain industry-level allocation if construct validity and research meaning are preserved.

decision.reason: The original proposal already studies industry weights; allocation across sectors can encode institution-specific judgments without testing individual-stock selection.
decision.sufficiency_condition: Document interpretation must affect a genuine allocation choice; changing gamma alone is only a numerical control and does not establish strategic-judgment coverage.
decision.not_a_result: This is a design-level adequacy judgment, not a claim that treatment effects or sufficient statistical power have been observed.

research_question: Does a common AI preserve source-specific public sector judgments in justified equity-sector allocations, and how does early versus late evidence provision change that reflection?

period.claim: retrospective document-conditioned case, not point-in-time trading replay

inputs: common market evidence in the same sector taxonomy
dated institution documents containing relevant objectives, applicable constraints or sector judgments
main.document_roles: Legal investment mandates, fund-manager commentary and house research views are distinct evidence types. A house outlook is not silently assigned to an unrelated fund as its mandate.
main.risk_policy: Preserve qualitative preferences; retain only explicitly supported numerical limits, denominators and exceptions. Do not map real-fund prose to gamma.
model_decisions: propose sector weights and explain the evidence supporting departures from a common baseline when one is specified
main.gold_visibility: Offline provisional references mechanically cross-checked; independent human review pending; never read by online runner.
main.calculation: Implemented pure calculator; automatic same feedback between stages; no repair or hidden-reference access
main.calculator_information_boundary: Tools may use only evidence already exposed in that run and model-submitted inputs. Before R4 receives its institution packet, tools cannot read hidden mandates, evaluator annotations or institution-specific constraints. Missing constraints remain unknown; no automatic gold-based repair, lookup or informative feasibility response is allowed.
main.no_synthetic_real_facts: Do not invent institutional expected returns, confidence, sector caps or exact target weights from qualitative prose.
pending: check actual runtime pin and full four-stage pilot evidence
freeze inputs, model and rubric before main responses
main.representation: Researcher-selected short paraphrased evidence, original labels, source IDs and page locators; not full-document retrieval.
main.baseline: Reported 2026-06-30 S&P500 sector weights, sum99.9%, original preserved and normalized for common arithmetic; not institution holdings/targets

blocking_design_decisions.issue: Inherited presence_penalty=1.5 is not a reported FinVector benchmark parameter; the paper does not report penalties.
blocking_design_decisions.required_before_main_freeze: Decide and document treatment of unreported model defaults, evidence strength and limitations; record any runtime/protocol revision and required pilot revalidation.

main.runtime_policy: candidate selected; actual readiness requires separate reviewed runtime and pilot evidence

workflow.interpretation: Evidence-onset and subsequent-use workflow policy, including position and context age; not an isolated memory mechanism.
workflow.retrieval: Directly supplied evidence first; actual retrieval quality remains a separate extension, not an executed RAG result.
workflow.inference: descriptive case study; two source documents, not powered population experiment
workflow.history_semantics: visible model responses and calculator feedback retained; not hidden thinking traces

dimensions: valid sector identifiers and feasible weights
institution-specific response under matched workflow comparison
evaluation.numeric_agreement: A unique exact-weight reference is used only for the independent numerical control. Public holdings or qualitative views do not specify universally correct strategic weights.
evaluation.convergence: Similarity alone is not failure. Report whether a convergence accompanies loss of relevant evidence or objective/constraint violations. Do not force differences when source judgments agree.
evaluation.counterfactuals: If constructed, change an explicitly identified condition while keeping others fixed and label these as synthetic task interventions, not real institution history.
evaluation.post_outcome_additions: Rubric refinements allowed on pilot only before main freeze; additions after main outcomes are exploratory, not revised confirmatory rules.
evaluation.primary_rating_scope: source label preservation only, not strategy quality

numerical_control.role: auxiliary check of explicit objective implementation; cannot substitute for the documentary strategic task
numerical_control.data_status: Revised historical French data; retrospective controlled task, not point-in-time trading reconstruction.
numerical_control.period_provenance: LIBERA adaptation: PortBench QA test years 2024-2025 plus Salcher 60-month lookback. Not PortBench pipeline replication.
numerical_control.inference: Overlapping fixed cases; no independent-sample or power claim. Shared optima retained. No future returns used.

legacy_v4.role: historical numerical prototype, not the new documentary main task
legacy_v4.audit_scope: The v4 two-round audit applies to archived v4 files and hashes only; it is not a certification of this revised documentary design.

model.settings_observation_scope: Reported inventory/request settings from supplied status evidence; observed values do not certify execution suitability.
model.runtime_readiness_policy: Installation or pilot status is reported separately; this builder never certifies execution readiness.

model_basis.scope: exact base model evaluated in finance; target decoding not fully disclosed
base Qwen3.5-4B; explicit JSON and disabled thinking; not the LoRA adapter

parameter_basis.note: Ollama implementation candidate; also T=0 in PortBench; not identical engine reproduction
Not FinVector's 700-token condition; adequacy checked on pilot, before main
Preserve all four stages including visible responses and calculation feedback; verify actual tokenization and memory

model.backend_settings: Pin served digest, quantization, chat template, engine, context, sampling defaults and thinking implementation from actual runtime evidence.
model.context_overflow: fail and record; no silent truncation, history deletion or budget change
limitations: financial base-model paper scores do not measure this quantized runtime
small-model application, not PortBench replication
basic task inability can obscure workflow differences
no hidden-thinking or memory mechanism identification

future_decoding_candidates_not_applied.basis: implementation translation of the author's minimal public example and MLX-LM 0.31.3 default argmax with logits_processors=None; NOT reported benchmark penalty values

model.future_candidate_scope: Not applied to the v4.3 research pilot/main protocol; separate engineering probes may use these values without establishing research validity.

submission.length_format_own_results_requirement: not specified in available overview; do not infer exemption

results.count_unit: ai_runs counts completed four-stage cases; calls counted separately; diagnostics excluded
results.count_source: observed_execution status input, or zero linked observations when no status supplied

notes: Exact tag/digest/engine/template consistency is checked from saved files; live service is not queried.
짧은 기술 진단 상태: 완료 기록. 로컬에서 확인한 완료 HTTP 응답: 1건. 예비 사례 수에 포함하지 않는다.
모델 기본 temperature와 실제 요청 temperature를 구분한다. show.parameters의 기본값 중 요청하지 않은 항목은 명시적으로 덮어쓰지 않았다.
기본값의 실제 적용 순서·효과는 엔진에 의존하며 FinVector의 전체 decoding 조건을 재현했다는 주장이 아니다.
호출 직전 pin 검증은 코드에 구현되어 있지만 조회 메타데이터를 호출별로 별도 저장하지 않았다. 최초 inventory, 요청·응답과 코드 해시가 보존 범위다.
설치·짧은 JSON 생성 성공은 전체 네 단계 수행이나 금융 판단의 유효성을 보장하지 않는다.
미수신 파일은 원격 미실행·실패를 뜻하지 않는다. not_started는 실제 coordinator 기록에서만 구분한다.
완료 응답 수는 저장된 HTTP 종료 응답 수이며 올바른 JSON·정확한 판단 수가 아니다.
완료 사례는 네 단계 record와 final 파일을 모두 확인한 수이며 내용의 의미 검토 완료가 아니다.
CANCEL 및 호출 기록에 따른 실행 중단이다. 시간 초과와 구분하며, 응답 미완료를 금융 판단의 의미 실패로 판정하지 않는다.

resources.scope: Sampled container-visible /proc, visible cgroup and named runtime process RSS; not an isolated physical host measurement.
limitations: RSS may double-count shared pages; cgroup includes cache and unrelated activity; do not add them.
memory.peak is an unreset cumulative high-water mark, not the maximum of interval samples.
Visible cgroup max does not establish effective ancestor/LXC limits; /proc may be virtualized.
Swap usage does not attribute paging or its speed effect to the model.
VRAM zero is a residency observation, not an inventory of physical server GPUs.
Allocated context does not prove that long inputs/history were preserved without truncation.

raw_cancel_record.reason: User requested response-time repair; stop current long pilot and preserve records before new engineering latency probes

cancellation.operator_supplement_scope: Additional operator-provided context; does not override raw timeout/cancel status.
cancellation.interpretation: Cancellation is distinct from timeout. A response absent at cancellation does not establish semantic failure.

notes: 이 실행 범위는 pilot 전용이다. 본과제 실행·평가규칙 동결을 이 보고서가 승인하지 않는다.
본과제 동결 전 설정 결정이 필요하다. FinVector는 penalty를 보고하지 않으므로 상속된 presence_penalty=1.5는 논문 기반 수치라고 정당화할 수 없다. 미보고 기본값의 처리·근거 수준·한계를 명시하고 필요한 조건 개정과 예비 재검증을 마쳐야 한다.
blocking_design_decisions: Resolve unreported inherited penalty defaults before main freeze; current pilot runtime is unchanged.

future_candidates_not_applied.reason: Candidate translation of the public minimal example and MLX-LM 0.31.3 default argmax/logits_processors=None to neutral Ollama penalties; the actual benchmark runner is private.

notes: 자동·독립 코드 검토를 사람의 원문·의미 검토 완료로 세지 않는다.
예비·기술 진단의 결과이며 학술제 본실험 결과가 아니다.
FinVector는 thinking 비활성화·JSON·greedy의 선례다. 양자화·엔진·상속 기본값이 달라 전체 재현을 주장하지 않는다.
8192 출력 상한은 PortBench의 값을 다른 모델·과제로 옮긴 적용이며 65536 문맥은 구현 후보다.
실행 중 설정을 바꾸지 않고, 평가 기준 보완은 예비 단계에서만 한 뒤 본과제 전에 동결한다.

별도 합성 속도 진단 관측: 4b_threads2: 감시 프로세스 제한시간 종료, 감시 120.003초, HTTP 미확인초, 첫 내용 미확인초, 수신 0 bytes; 4b_threads4: 감시 프로세스 제한시간 종료, 감시 120.002초, HTTP 미확인초, 첫 내용 미확인초, 수신 0 bytes; 1p7b_threads2: 완료 기록, 감시 61.176초, HTTP 61.083초, 첫 내용 59.669초, 수신 977 bytes. 설정별 한 번의 공학 점검이며 예비·본과제 완료 수에 합산하지 않는다. 제한시간 종료는 완료시간이 아니며 모델·문맥·벌점 등 구성 차이로 일반적인 성능 배율을 계산하지 않는다.
실제 문서 첫 단계의 별도 기술 점검(qwen3:1.7b): 감시 프로세스 제한시간 종료, 감시 180.003초, 수신 0 bytes. 압축 입력만 보낸 32-token 상한의 단일 요청이며 원형 대비 속도 개선이나 네 단계 적합성을 입증하지 않는다. 현재 속도 문제의 해결과 작은 모델의 연구 과제 충족은 확인되지 않았다.

stop                           "<|im_end|>"
temperature                    0.6

supervisor_result.deadline_scope: Child process lifetime includes setup, connect, headers and complete stream; OS scheduling/kill overhead is separately included in elapsed_seconds.

resources.scope: Sampled container-visible /proc, visible cgroup and named runtime process RSS; not an isolated physical host measurement.
limitations: RSS may double-count shared pages; cgroup includes cache and unrelated activity; do not add them.
memory.peak is an unreset cumulative high-water mark, not the maximum of interval samples.
Visible cgroup max does not establish effective ancestor/LXC limits; /proc may be virtualized.
Swap usage does not attribute paging or its speed effect to the model.
VRAM zero is a residency observation, not an inventory of physical server GPUs.
Allocated context does not prove that long inputs/history were preserved without truncation.

observations.interpretation_limits: Only the compact version was sent. Exact-value round-trip is not equal-model-behavior evidence; no original/compact latency ratio, four-stage feasibility, financial quality or speed-resolution claim.

pins.inherited_parameters:
top_k                          20
top_p                          0.95
repeat_penalty                 1
stop                           "<|im_start|>"
stop                           "<|im_end|>"
temperature                    0.6

windows_memory.interpretation: Named process working sets may double-count shared pages; system available RAM and commit have distinct scopes. No cgroup or dedicated VRAM capacity is inferred.

observations.deadline_source: saved supervisor_result.deadline_seconds; summary display text does not override execution values

observations.scope: Real first-stage input engineering feasibility only; no semantic scoring or research case completion.

supervisor.deadline_scope: Child process lifetime includes setup, connect, headers and complete stream; OS scheduling/kill overhead is separately included in elapsed_seconds.

reported_summary.deadline_scope: 120-second maximum applies to the supervised child lifetime; metadata checks and cleanup are outside that bound.

invocation.condition_basis: Output cap32, context32768/65536, thread/batch settings, decoding overrides and timeout are engineering probe controls, not a claimed paper-condition replication.
invocation.interpretation_limits: One first-stage request. No allocation/rating scoring, no full workflow verdict, no original-versus-compact latency comparison; OS file cache is not evicted.

validation.interpretation: Bytes and conservative screen are not actual tokenizer counts or speed predictions.

supervisor_result.deadline_scope: Child process lifetime includes setup, connect, headers and complete stream; OS scheduling/kill overhead is separately included in elapsed_seconds.

resources.scope: Sampled container-visible /proc, visible cgroup and named runtime process RSS; not an isolated physical host measurement.
limitations: RSS may double-count shared pages; cgroup includes cache and unrelated activity; do not add them.
memory.peak is an unreset cumulative high-water mark, not the maximum of interval samples.
Visible cgroup max does not establish effective ancestor/LXC limits; /proc may be virtualized.
Swap usage does not attribute paging or its speed effect to the model.
VRAM zero is a residency observation, not an inventory of physical server GPUs.
Allocated context does not prove that long inputs/history were preserved without truncation.

observations.interpretation_limits: Only the compact version was sent. Exact-value round-trip is not equal-model-behavior evidence; no original/compact latency ratio, four-stage feasibility, financial quality or speed-resolution claim.

windows_memory.interpretation: Named process working sets may double-count shared pages; system available RAM and commit have distinct scopes. No cgroup or dedicated VRAM capacity is inferred.

observations.deadline_source: saved supervisor_result.deadline_seconds; summary display text does not override execution values

local_engineering_addendum.historical_observed_execution_scope: Unchanged remote CT record; local observations are stored in this separate appendix.
